mapper.select: INSERT INTO app_chat_message_feedback ( tenant_id, feedback_id, session_id, assistant_message_id, user_id, rating, labels_json, comment, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{feedbackId}, session.id, message.id, session.user_id, #{rating}, CAST(#{labelsJson} AS JSONB), #{comment}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedAt} FROM app_chat_session session JOIN app_chat_message message ON message.id = #{assistantMessageId} AND message.tenant_id = session.tenant_id AND message.session_id = session.id AND message.role = 'assistant' WHERE session.id = #{sessionId} AND session.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session.user_id = #{userId} AND session.status = 'ACTIVE' AND session.deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, assistant_message_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, labels_json = EXCLUDED.labels_json, comment = EXCLUDED.comment, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE app_chat_message_feedback.session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id AND app_chat_message_feedback.tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id AND app_chat_message_feedback.user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id RETURNING feedback_id
